g.text: Drop files or folders from Explorer onto a folder to upload them there; double-click a file to download it; right-click for more.
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

The header buttons are Upload (prominent), Download, a glyph-only new folder button, a glyph-only ⌂ home button, Reconnect (only when the session is closed) and ✕, then ⟳. The new folder and home glyphs are Segoe MDL2 icons, drawn

The status line over the tree changes during transfers ('Uploading … · 2 more waiting') and shows a 'Show in folder' link after a download. Right-clicking a row offers Download…/Download folder…, Upload files here…, Upload a
folder here…, New folder…, Refresh, Copy path, Rename… and Delete.

While connecting it shows 'Connecting to forge@web-1…' and 'A password or an unknown host key is asked for in a window of its own.' On failure it shows 'Could not connect to …' and 'Connect again'. Password and host-key prompts
come up as Win32 MessageBox dialogs ('Trust this server?'), not as Briareus windows.
The empty state is 'No open sessions — Click a server on the left to browse its files here…'.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
